Interface SettingsChild

All Known Subinterfaces:
SettingsParent
All Known Implementing Classes:
BooleanSetting, CameraProperties, ComplexSetting, DoubleSetting, EditorProperties, EnumSetting, IntSetting, SceneProperties, Setting, Settings, StringSetting
public sealed interface SettingsChild permits SettingsParent, Setting<T>
An interface for a child of a settings folder.

This interface allows for the creation of a hierarchical structure of settings, where each folder can contain other folders or individual settings. This is useful for organizing a large number of settings in a logical way.

This interface is implemented by SettingsParent and Setting.
